summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel RT (Live Patch 16 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 16)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.12.0-160000.37.1 fixes various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-63888: scsi: target: iscsi: Fix CRC overread and double-free in iscsit_handle_text_cmd() (bsc#1272391).
- CVE-2026-63917: ip6: vti: Use ip6_tnl.net in vti6_changelink() (bsc#1273015).
- CVE-2026-63920: ipv6: validate extension header length before copying to cmsg (bsc#1273012).
- CVE-2026-63921: ip6: vti: Use ip6_tnl.net in vti6_siocdevprivate() (bsc#1273011).
- CVE-2026-64000: net: hsr: fix potential OOB access in supervision frame handling (bsc#1273052).
- CVE-2026-64114: ipv4: raw: reject IP_HDRINCL packets with ihl < 5 (bsc#1273833).
- CVE-2026-64121: net: ifb: report ethtool stats over num_tx_queues (bsc#1273837).
- CVE-2026-68121: pppoe: reload header pointer after dev_hard_header() (bsc#1275228).
- CVE-2026-72217: SUNRPC: Bound-check xdr_buf_to_bvec() stores before writing (bsc#1276299).
- CVE-2026-74394: RDMA/srpt: fix integer overflow in immediate data length check (bsc#1277409).
- CVE-2026-74612: veth: fix skb length accounting after XDP frag adjustment (bsc#1277506).
